oak = a large tree that produces acorns
pine = an evergreen tree with needles and cones
bird = an animal with feathers and wings that usually flies
nest = a home that a bird builds for its eggs
feather = one of the light parts that cover a bird's body
beak = the hard mouth of a bird
wing = the part a bird or insect uses to fly
fish = an animal that lives in water and has gills
whale = a very large sea animal that breathes air
dolphin = an intelligent sea animal that looks like a small whale
shark = a large fish with sharp teeth
bear = a large wild animal with thick fur
wolf = a wild animal like a large dog that lives in packs
fox = a wild animal with a thick tail and red-brown fur
deer = a wild animal with long legs; males often have antlers
rabbit = a small animal with long ears that lives in holes
squirrel = a small animal with a bushy tail that lives in trees
hedgehog = a small animal with spikes on its back
bee = a flying insect that makes honey and can sting
butterfly = an insect with large colourful wings
